thread:
eli_product: Quick flag from the dash UX review: the small help panel on /models lists actions as \"Run\" but the docs and API use \"Execute\". Users were confused during testing. We should unify. zoe_docs: Yep saw that in the docs audit. We previously used \"Execute\" to match API verbs. But console nav uses shorter verbs, that's why \"Run\" slipped in. peter_frontend: From an implementation POV the help panel is rendered by shared component `InProductDocCard`. Changing copy is 1-line, but we should pick a canonical term. Thoughts? mike_pm: Product preference: keep UI verbs short and action-oriented: \"Run\" in the console, but in docs we can show both: \"Run (Execute)\" on first mention. That keeps API parity while preserving concise UI. zoe_docs: I'm wary of parenthetical jargon. For consistency across links/crosswalks I'd prefer canonical id mapping: docs use id=execute, but the UI shows \"Run\". If we include a tooltip \"Run = Execute (API)\" that's clearer. anna_a11y: Accessibility: whatever we choose, the in-product docs link needs aria-describedby mapping to the explanatory tooltip. Also stable IDs on headings for deep links. If the UI term differs from the heading id, screen readers can be confused when jump lands on a heading labelled \"Execute\" while the trigger said \"Run\". peter_frontend: Good catch. Implementation plan proposal: 1) Add `data-doc-id=\"execute\"` to the trigger, 2) update overlay to read heading by id and expose `aria-labelledby`, 3) update tooltip text to \"Run (Executes model)\". I can spike this in a single PR. zoe_docs: I'll update docs headings to include both stable id and human-friendly title, e.g., `

Execute (run a model)

`. That satisfies both linkability and clarity. mike_pm: Acceptance criteria: headings have stable ids, in-product triggers include `data-doc-id`, tooltips added, and copy guide updated. Priority: P2. eli_product: Also request: cross-link behavior from docs->console should preserve context. Example: https://console/redwood/models?help=execute should open the docs panel and land on the Execute section. Can we support both `#execute` and `?help=execute`? peter_frontend: We can support both easily. We'll handle `?help=` on initial route and on pushState. Edge cases: ensure SSR routing doesn't strip query before hydrating. anna_a11y: QA note: when landing via `?help=execute` the focus must be inside the overlay and announced. Test with NVDA/VoiceOver. Also test visible focus ring on the heading. zoe_docs: I'll add a short alias table in docs: maps UI label -> doc id -> API verb. That will be used by SDKs and the console microcopy generator. mike_pm: Please also add a small analytics event `docs_panel_open` with `source: \"in_product_help\"` and `doc_id` so we can measure friction. peter_frontend: Will add telemetry. Devops-bot: CI pipeline note: docs site deploy scheduled tonight; if Zoe's heading IDs land after that we might need a tiny redirect. zoe_docs: I'll coordinate deploy timing. Will also add a redirect rule for legacy anchors. eli_product: Thanks folks. Can we aim to have PRs by EOD Thur so we can include in next sprint? Tag me for copy signoff. :sparkles:
